description: Target-sized controlled Stage 2 fixture with support, contradiction, qualification, and neutral distractor evidence for synthesis review scaffolding.

case_design.human_review_boundary: The fixture is deterministic scaffolding for review and regression; it is not a claim about naturally occurring evidence quality.

cases.question: What does the evidence say about data center load and grid stress?

evidence.title: Grid Planning Support Memo
evidence.text: The grid planning assessment reports that data center load increased substation peak demand during 2025.

evidence.title: Grid Planning Audit Challenge
evidence.text: The grid planning audit says data center load did not increase substation peak demand during 2025 after controls.

evidence.title: Grid Planning Boundary Note
evidence.text: Although data center load increased substation peak demand in some observations, the grid planning finding depends on interconnection timing and cooling schedules and remains limited.

evidence.title: Grid Planning Administrative Notice
evidence.text: The administrative notice describes regional arts funding for routine operations and contains no analysis of the grid planning outcome.
